title: Standard Motorcycle
body:
Standard Motorcycle is a general-purpose motorcycle with an upright riding position, a middleweight engine, and no fairing, built for everyday riding. Standard motorcycles are the default motorbike, and they suit commuting, touring, and learning alike.

The standard motorcycle is the most versatile motorbike type, and its simplicity is its virtue.

title: Cruiser Motorcycle
body:
Cruiser Motorcycle is a motorcycle built for relaxed, low-speed riding, with a low seat, swept-back handlebars, and a large-displacement engine. Cruisers, led by Harley-Davidson, are a cultural icon of American motorcycling, with their own rallies, clubs, and style.

Cruisers are motorcycling's laid-back type, and their sound and stance are recognised everywhere.

title: Sport Motorcycle

title: Scooter
body:

Scooters are the city bike, and their ease of use made two wheels accessible to millions.
